ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the $11 million case involving a Kenyan-linked man.
questions: How did the defendant manage to steal $11 million from Medicaid?
Are there any connections to other cases or entities?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of fraud and corruption in Minnesota's Medicaid program. I will use data analysis and public records to follow the money and identify potential suspects and entities involved.
